notes.title: Conclusion of Chapter 2 is now released !!!
notes.content:
Hi, in this Update, we have concluded the Story of Chapter 2.
Along with the details of new Updates,
We would like to tell you our plan for the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37442376/bba1004afb208e9c89f15f5ac8d95d7725a6f321.png[/img]

---------------------------

JeDam is a Boss and NPC Specific Class,
and the only Class in the Game where all Characters have Unique Model and Statuses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37442376/8e02ef86d3e3e5a8b225e75c46a7cf8741a615c4.png[/img]

Countess Claudia Nordauge, "The Eyes of the Empire",
is the Head of Ordo Policia,
the Military Police that takes care of Enemies Within.

In addition to impressive Attacking Skills,

Her extended Vision Angle made it extremely difficult to make Flank Attacks against her.

Her extended Melee Range allow her to initiate Melee from behind other Squads.

Which made her extremely hard to deal with.

---------------------------

In previous Builds,
we have issues with Damage calculation,
where it is near impossible to defeat some Enemies without knowing their exact weaknesses.

New Formula is now used to ensure that a bare minimum Damage will went through.

To counter this change, 
Parry and Dodge mechanic is now fixed,
to allow some chances of nullifying Damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37442376/212f2e7a5e30a329a350542e6392b18516d2fe77.png[/img]

Parry for Melee Attack,
Dodge for Shooting Attack,
These 2 Statuses will increase chances to nullify Damage.
When success, UI will show a Shield Icon instead of Damage Number.

If failed to nullify, they will still mitigate a small portion Damage as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37442376/d1a5002ded4475f3ff90396e8cea1ff45984c249.png[/img]

-----------------------------------------

In addition to affecting Critical chances,
Bravery and Instinct will also affect chances to nullify Damage as well.

But unlike Parry and Dodge,
they will not help mitigate Damage when failed.

This can be countered with Critical Damage,
which totally bypass the process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37442376/49f6320a39235ba00fd64b9f8f4cf736fe6b0ae2.png[/img]

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

||| PLANS FOR THE FUTURE |||

------------------

We have made changes in the Development Plan
to prioritize completing the Main Story as quickly as possible.

------------------

Since the Early Access release,
we have made Updates of 1-2 Episodes per Month.

But we found that 
trying to finish an Episode at a time caused various disruptions in the workflow.

From this point on,
we will switch to a Chapter per Update instead.

A Chapter will contain ~4 Major Episodes,
which might take around ~ 4 Months.

Having 3 Chapters left to create,
it would take us around a Year until the Full Release.

----------------------

Mini-Stories will be implemented in Side Chapters instead.

These Episodes will give insights on some Plot Holes in the Main Story.
And Players can choose to skip them if preferred.

In the initial Full Release, these Episodes will not be included.
But is planned to be available as Free Updates later on.

------------------
------------------

Currently,
Our Upgrade System used Coins to Upgrade Keywords within obtained Doctrines,
and use Keyword Stocks to upgrade individual Unit.

Doctrines can be obtained from Choices Selection.
While Keyword Stocks and Coins can be obtained depending on how you cleared the Stage.

Coins, Keyword Stock, Doctrine

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37442376/e052cf49bead0dd10a70c17bec75bf162e9faba4.png[/img]

Not only does it sound confusing,
the number of Keywords available made it extremely hard for us to balance out rewards.

---------

To make things simpler for everyone,

In the next update,
Choices and how you clear the Stage will grant Doctrine only instead.

When Doctrine is obtained,
then it will automatically upgrade related Keywords,
and grant Global Bonuses to each Unit's Keyword LV.

---------------

This method will make it easier for Players to Upgrade,
as well as reducing workloads needed for a Full release.

-----------------------------
-----------------------------

Regarding Voice Acting

Due to subpar qualities made by AI Voice Synthesizer,
we have decided to wait until we have completed all Stories before hiring Voice Actors.

Instead of doing per Update,
We need to do this at the end to minimize Production Cost.

----------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------

Thank you for reading,
and have a nice Warmongering !!!

notes.title: 2023 June Update - Flame in the Forest
notes.content:
Hi there,

2 Episodes have been added to this Build

2-4 1/2 Crossroad
2-4 2/2 Scheelite

--------------------------------

This Stage introduce how the Fire Mechanic work in the Game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37442376/261e56294ec93f1dfba5abbfb03ec2e640497310.png[/img]

Most Objects in the Stage,
Buildings, Trees, Plants, etc, can be lit on Fire.

While the Object still have HP left at the start of the Turn,
it will continue to burn, and deal Fire Damage to Squads in proximity.

----------------------------------

Executioner-Brazer is an Elite Shooting Unit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37442376/831f7d7fe9f62a3d87bb2fbe6056d265190b3f98.png[/img]

They can add Fire Damage to Bullets,
as well as using Fireball Spell.

After putting everything on Fire,
They can protect themselves with high Fire Resistance,
while Fire Damage chipped away HP of their opponents.

----------------------------------

There are two major ways to Counter this,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37442376/261e56294ec93f1dfba5abbfb03ec2e640497310.png[/img]

[Heal] Spell can be used to extinguish Fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37442376/4a945b3052b2782a66e3fc769dcab8a4ad7febb9.png[/img]

And [Flame grant Me Strength] will convert all Fire in the Proximity to Stamina.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you are aiming for a Fire Build,

You could use Fireball to burn everything around you along with Enemies,
use [Flame grant me Strength] to recover Stamina,
allowing the process to be loop each turn.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------

Stamina Control will play a Major role in later Stages,
and [Flame grant me Strength] is one of an option available for now.

We will keep adding more Skills to counter with Stamina Deficiency.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------

Also,

There are issues with voice acting, and we are not satisfied with it.
This is mostly due to voice artifacts caused by AI generation.

In the next update,
we will try other methods that could improve quality.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thank you for reading,

and have a nice Enemy on Fire !

notes.title: Fix Minor Bugs
notes.content:
Hi, a small Fix today.

-----------------
Serious Stuff
-----------------

There are times where the Game won't continue during Enemy's Movement Phase.
We are not certain of what caused this,
but figured that it might be due to Pathfinding Issue .
- We have implemented a fix, and the problem did not occur again thus far.

-----------------
Minor Stuff
-----------------

Screen Resolution adjusted by the Player was recorded in the Save File,
but wasn't apply each time the Game Started.
- This has been fixed.

notes.title: New Stage Added, Army Editing now available
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hear Ye ! Hear Ye ![/b][/h1]

After the Assassination of the Emperor,
Rumors has it that the Patricide Princess is being imprisoned in the Eastern Fort.

The Princess Guard has rushed their way to free their Liege,
but can they penetrate the Guns and Shields of the 2nd Legion !

Stay tune for the next Episode of Historica Fantasia !!!!

----------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------

Hi everyone,

This Game was released in Early Access since April 2023,
but I didn't wrote any announcement at the time 
due to currently limited Contents.

In the Early Access section,
we mentioned there will be Monthly Updates,
and here it is.

-------------------------

In this Update,

We have added 2 Episodes,
2-2 - New Frontier Fort
2-3 - I am not alone

Army Editing Function can be unlocked once you completed these 2 Episodes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37442376/61da193c583962c92bbf9286eb8c5f66d8491f72.png[/img]

-----------------

[h2][b][2-2 - New Frontier Fort][/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37442376/2b0dd0aefc6a28fa29d80c4fb316f1b3fd0f808f.png[/img]

This will be the last Stage in the Main Story that will use Preset Squads.

After this Stage, You will be able to field the Army that you have edited yourself.

A new feature we have implemented,
is the stationary Vortex Shield,
that act as a Bunker type Object to protect a Squad from incoming Missiles.

-------------------

[h2][b][2-3 - I am not alone][/b][/h2]

To complement unlocking Army Editing.
This is an Event-Only Episode,
where you can select who to join from various groups of Selection.

Core Troops provided will be solid enough to survive most Tasks,
while Optional Troops can provide some Specialties to your Force. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37442376/df9ff10d5ba31ba854a95236e9d1951777d26ec5.png[/img]

-------------------------------------
-------------------------------------

A warning for Players who have played Earlier Version.

Moreno, or another Character, will join you
depending on how you decided his Fate in Episode [0-1 - Holy Portland (1869)].

But due to Bugs in the previous Build,
we had to fix things that eventually made that record unreadable.

If you continue to Play with previous Save,
the Event will still go through the end,
but neither of the Character will appear.

You will have to start a New Game in order for this to work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37442376/d8903b4a3738113cc884f524856242ddc945cc9a.png[/img]

----------------------------------------

Thank you for reading this Announcement,
and see you next Month for a new Update !
